name: Stage 13 target-domain normal-print augmentation set

collection.methodology: Continuous real-time FDM footage from fixed cameras; one sample every 35-50 seconds far into each source (two offset passes at 35s and 50s), capped at 60 samples/source; long sources capped to first 6h span.
collection.screening: Per-frame VLM review (local qwen/qwen3-vl-8b) with a strict neutral single-frame prompt; accepted only if decision==normal AND part_visible==True.
collection.continuity: Source-level continuity screening (adjacent-frame structural diff) confirmed all selected sources are unedited continuous real-time footage.
collection.source_grouping: Every source entirely in ONE role. 7 sources train, 2 sources held-out eval (LY3jlcO34f4, zkJgLanCSUw). No frame-level splitting.
